profile.headline: Sr. Full Stack Java Developer | Sr. Java Backend Engineer | Spring Boot - GraphQL - Microservices | AWS - Kubernetes-CI/CD | illinois + Remote
profile.summary:
Senior Full Stack Java Developer with 10+ years of experience designing and delivering scalable, cloud-native enterprise applications — most recently at Flagstar Bank, where I built and maintained backend services and cloud-native infrastructure for enterprise banking operations at scale.

My core strength: translating complex business requirements into production-grade Spring Boot microservices, secure RESTful APIs, and cloud-native architectures that deliver measurable results — 35% improvement in API response time, 99.9% uptime, 60% faster release velocity through CI/CD automation. 

What I build: 
→ Backend: Java, Spring Boot 3, Spring Security, Spring Cloud, Hibernate/JPA, Node.js, GraphQL, Kafka, JMS 
→ Frontend: React 18, Angular, TypeScript, Redux, Material UI, WCAG Accessibility 
→ Cloud amp; DevOps: AWS (S3, EC2, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, IAM, DynamoDB), Docker, Kubernetes (EKS), Terraform, Jenkins, GitHub Actions 
→ Security: JWT/OAuth2/OIDC, Spring Security, RBAC, OWASP-aligned API security 
→ Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, X-Ray, ELK Stack 

Portfolio projects (K21 Academy Java Full Stack Program): 
→ Cloud-Native Order Management System — Spring Boot 3, JWT/RBAC, AWS SQS/S3, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions CI/CD 
→ Real-Time Transaction Monitoring Dashboard — Spring Boot, WebSockets, Kafka, Prometheus/Grafana, React 

MS Computer Science — Governors State University, Illinois 

Open to: Senior Full Stack Java Developer · Sr. Java Backend Engineer · Java Software Engineer · Spring Boot Developer opportunities

positions.title: Senior Java Full-Stack Developer
positions.description:
→ Designed and delivered Java-based backend services using Spring Boot and RESTful APIs — improving average response time by 35% for large-scale financial applications 
→ Implemented Spring Security with JWT and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) — ensuring compliance with banking security standards and OWASP guidelines 
→ Delivered cloud-native solutions using Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS — maintaining 99.9% uptime for enterprise banking applications 
→ Enhanced system stability through Prometheus/Grafana monitoring and centralized logging — reducing production downtime by 35% 
→ Automated CI/CD workflows and integrated JWT/OAuth2 security while modernizing legacy SOAP services to REST

positions.title: Senior Java Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed microservices, record, and loyalty engines using Java, Spring Boot, GraphQL, and REST API, reducing API response time and ensuring scalable integration across services hosted on Azure.
•	Developed AWS-native serverless applications using Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, and IaC (CloudFormation/Terraform), accelerating development cycles by 40% through automated, repeatable deployments.
•	Implemented secure authentication and authorization (JWT, OAuth2/OIDC, Cognito, LDAP/AD) and aligned with OWASP and InfoSec standards while modernizing legacy services to REST.
•	Built high-throughput ETL pipelines with AWS Glue, PySpark, and event-driven messaging (Kafka, JMS, ActiveMQ), boosting data processing capacity to 2M+ records/hour with reduced latency.
•	Automated CI/CD workflows using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and Bamboo with strong test coverage, increasing release velocity by 60% and improving deployment reliability.
•	Strengthened observability using CloudWatch, X-Ray, Prometheus/Grafana, and centralized logging, lowering MTTR and production downtime by 40%.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Built and deployed enterprise Java applications using Java EE, JSP/Servlets, Struts, Spring MVC, and EJBs on WebSphere and Tomcat.
•	Developed SOAP and early REST services with JAX-WS/JAX-RS, and modernized legacy Struts 1.x systems to Struts 2/Spring MVC.
•	Implemented data persistence using Hibernate and JDBC, and developed UI components with HTML/CSS, JavaScript, and jQuery.
•	Automated builds with Ant/Maven, managed version control in Bitbucket, and configured JDBC data sources and server deployments.
•	Followed Agile/Scrum practices and improved quality with JUnit tests and Mockito-based mocking.
